title: SMOK X-PRIV Solo 80W Mod
description:
The
SMOK X-PRIV Solo 80W Mod
is a compact box mod with adjustable wattage up to 80W. Features a dual touchscreen display with switchable themes, haptic feedback, and intelligent atomizer recognition. Requires a single 18650 battery (sold separately).
Product Type:
Box Mod (Battery Only - No Tank)
Wattage Range:
5-80W
Battery:
Single 18650 (sold separately)
Charging:
USB Type-C (2.5A Fast Charging)
Display:
Dual Touchscreen with Haptic Feedback
Connection:
510 Thread
Resistance Range:
0.1-2.5Ω
Compatible Tanks:
SMOK TF-D Subtank (with D-Coils), or any 510-threaded tank/atomizer
Brand:
SMOK
Tank, battery, and e-liquid sold separately. Pair with the SMOK TF-D Subtank and D-Coils for the intended setup.
Available options: Black Shell, Silver Lines.
